description: The College of Glamour is the home of bards who inspire wonder through magic and enchantment. These bards wield their magic through glittering performance and illusion.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: When you use Bardic Inspiration, the recipient gains temporary hit points equal to the number rolled on the Inspiration die plus your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.description: When you perform for at least 1 minute, choose a number of humanoids equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) who watched and listened to you. They must make a Charisma save or be Charmed by you. While Charmed, they have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to perceive any creature other than you.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration (Enhanced)
features.description: A creature that gains temporary hit points from Mantle of Inspiration also gains advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can spend 4 Bardic Inspiration uses to cast the spell Enthrall. As a reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll against you, you can add your Charisma modifier to your AC against the attack.
